name: Text My Lights
author: Nick Spica (thespica93)
description: Viewers text a name that appears on your light display - via Twilio SMS or Google Voice. Runs as a background layer on the Pi so it can play alongside your main show; use sequences (.fseq) for Waiting and Name Display content - video and playlists are not supported at this time. Includes message queueing, profanity filtering, name whitelist/blocklist, auto-responses, per-phone rate limiting, and duplicate detection.

privacy.summary: Names people text to your show are relayed through your Twilio or Google Voice account and shown on your lights; sender phone numbers and messages are stored on this device to run the display.

sends.what: Reads inbound SMS (sender number + text) from your Twilio account (read-only).
Reads Google Voice SMS-to-email (sender + text); sends reply texts and admin approval prompts.
sends.why: Receive texted names via Google Voice; send replies and approval prompts

sends.to: Other FPP instances on your LAN (http://<peer>:5000)
sends.what: In Master/Remote mode the master pushes the texted name and show state to remotes.

collects.what: Sender phone numbers and texted names/messages
Blocked and approved phone numbers / names
Live Name Approval: admin phone number and Gmail relay address
Pending/expired name-approval requests: texter number, message and name.
Per-phone daily profanity-strike counts (used for auto-blocking)
Your Twilio auth token and Gmail app password

systemChanges.what: Adds an /etc/sudoers.d rule so a validated root helper can make the overlay model's /dev/shm file group-writable for pixel rendering.
Runs a local web service on 0.0.0.0:5000 for the settings UI and Master/Remote sync between FPP instances on your LAN.
Installs apt packages: fonts-freefont-ttf, fontconfig, python3-zstandard, and the Python libraries listed in dependencies.
Copies bundled fonts to /usr/local/share/fonts/fpp-plugin-textmylights/ and installs fpp-plugin-textmylights-Start.sh / -Stop.sh into media/scripts.

privacy.other: Credentials are stored in an owner-only (0600) file and removed on uninstall. Twilio is read-only: the plugin never sends via Twilio. Google Voice reply texts are on by default, and Live Name Approval also texts the admin approval prompts. In Master/Remote mode the master pushes the texted name and show state to your other FPP instances on the LAN (/api/tml/state, /api/tml/stop) to display in sync. Pending/expired name-approval requests are kept indefinitely when the approval timeout is set to 0. The settings UI has no separate login: anyone who can open this device's FPP web UI can reach it, consistent with FPP itself. No data goes to third parties beyond your own Twilio/Google accounts and your own FPP devices.
